run_caption_dedup_cli: run the CLI to deduplicate overlapping video caption sentences from a how2 dataset directory
build_dedup_processor: build a CaptionDedupProcessor from a pickle file containing video captions and run deduplication on all videos
test_dedup_single_video: test the dedup logic on a single video by calling single with a video ID to see before and after
finalize_dedup_pickle: finalize deduplicated captions by writing the processed data to a target pickle file
review_dedup_statistics: review deduplication statistics including clip length, tokens per second, and number of clips per video
